gen-gf-oxanium-gf-lexend-tera: Sharp and a bit futuristic, Oxanium stands tall with big lowercase and clean monoline strokes. And if that heading ever shrank, Lexend Tera's plain sans letters, spaced like stepping stones, would start to drown it out.
gen-cinzel-decorative-bitter: Bitter reads sturdy and friendly, with a huge lowercase eye and an s you can see straight through. But Cinzel Decorative is what gives the pair its character, its widely spaced capitals carrying a faint shimmer of heavy and light.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-lexend-zetta: Paprika's lowercase fills the line like capitals, loud and scattered. Lexend Zetta's sans runs wide and loosely tracked beneath it, so paragraphs move slowly and breathe, like a conversation with nobody rushing.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-julius-sans-one: Playful, stencil-cut Snowburst One has wide bridges between its tall letters. Julius Sans One is a plain sans with hairline stretches of space, so a modest heading size lets the body keep up with it.
gen-dafont-blockletter-poppins: Precise is the word for Blockletter, whose tall midsection looks sketched with one unpressed pencil. Poppins follows with the same unmodulated line, its sans curves loose and its lowercase sturdy, so the page feels tidy and modern.
gen-dafont-bloody-poppins: Big round bowls, loud and unruly: that is Bloody. Poppins settles beside it as a plain sans with loose, unknotted curves, giving the outline-style heading a sturdy, tall-bodied companion to lean on.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-poppins: Poppins reads smooth and modern, its plain sans lowercase tall and sturdy with no thick-thin flicker. Capture Smallz brings raw, big-bodied lowercase of unmodulated line, and that rough-versus-smooth gap is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-poppins: Poppins is the sans-serif here, loose-curved and modern, with a tall sturdy lowercase. Ethnocentric, fast and aggressive, with short ascenders over big bowls and widely pushed tracking, gives the pair its speed against that composure.
gen-dafont-galaxy-poppins: Galaxy's line never changes width, and its dense, tall lowercase band floats in loose letterfit. Yet Poppins, a modern sans with sturdy tall letters, grounds all that space and makes the cosmic look feel approachable.
gen-dafont-groovy-poppins: Poppins reads modern and unfussy, a sans with loose curves and tall, sturdy lowercase. Meanwhile Groovy's c almost closes into a narrow slit, so its funky, friendly heading sits against open body letters.
